verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a CRM, since some CRMs ship self-hostable editions, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Pipedrive offering a self-hosted or on-premise deployment; the pack describes a hosted SaaS with an API, webhooks and an MCP server. The developer sandbox account is a hosted test environment, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
